question: What was NVIDIA's total revenue for fiscal 2026, in USD millions, and how much did it grow vs fiscal 2025?
grading: ±0.5% on revenue, USD millions; period must be FY ended 2026-01-25; growth ±0.5pp; fail if any CY2026 or FY2027 quarter used
answer: NVIDIA FY2026 revenue was USD 215,938 million, versus USD 130,497 million in FY2025: growth of 65.4735% (65% as rounded in the filing). [G01-E1]

output.answer:

**NVIDIA Fiscal 2026 Revenue:** **$215,900 million** ($215.9 billion)

**Year-over-Year Growth:** **65%** vs. fiscal 2025

This implies fiscal 2025 revenue was approximately **$130,900 million** (~$130.9 billion).

**Source(s):**
- Yahoo Finance: "Nvidia's valuation just hit a multiyear low — even as revenue sets records" — fiscal 2026 revenue topped $215.9 billion, up 65% year over year. ([finance.yahoo.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidias-valuation-just-hit-a-multiyear-low--even-as-revenue-sets-records-155948933.html))

**Note on timing:** NVIDIA's fiscal year ends in January, so fiscal 2026 ended January 31, 2026. A separate figure of ~$187.1 billion cited in other coverage refers to a trailing twelve-month or calendar period, not the official fiscal year-end total.
